capabilities: Sync the vault to a RustShare instance via manual full scans or automatic incremental uploads
Resolve conflicts by creating conflict copies instead of overwriting
Queue changes made offline and sync them when the connection is restored
Pair a device with the RustShare server using a pairing code
Show real-time sync status in the status bar
extras: Not yet in the Obsidian Community Plugins marketplace; manual installation required. Desktop only (Obsidian v0.15.0+). Manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault to a self-hosted backend; users must rely on the official hosted Sync service or roll their own.

relations.evidence: Sync your local Obsidian vault to RustShare — a self-hosted vault synchronization backend

requires.name: RustShare instance with Vault Sync API enabled

summary: Vault sync client that synchronizes a local Markdown vault with a self-hosted RustShare backend, with conflict copies and offline queueing.
